optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Delivery Project Coordinator, Customer Ticketing System

professionalSummary.text: Experienced Delivery Project Coordinator with two years of end-to-end ownership of enterprise implementation projects, maintaining implementation plans, action logs, and consultant schedules in project tools while managing customer status calls and risk escalations.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the implementation plan, action log and consultant schedule for six enterprise implementations in the project tool, keeping the customer-facing status page current each week. Prepared and hosted the weekly customer status call for my assigned implementations, recording decisions and actions; scope and commercial questions on the call were answered by the delivery manager. Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with an option each; consultant assignments were decided by the delivery manager, and customer go-live was signed off by the customer's project sponsor with the delivery manager. Responsibilities included plan and log maintenance, status calls, risk escalation and close-out reports for enterprise implementations over about two years in the delivery team.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained implementation plans, action logs, and consultant schedules for six enterprise implementations using project tools, ensuring customer-facing status updates were current weekly.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the implementation plan, action log and consultant schedule for six enterprise implementations in the project tool, keeping the customer-facing status page current each week.

experienceHighlights.text: Hosted weekly customer status calls, recording decisions and actions, with scope and commercial questions handled by the delivery manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared and hosted the weekly customer status call for my assigned implementations, recording decisions and actions; scope and commercial questions on the call were answered by the delivery manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with recommended options, while consultant assignments and customer go-live sign-off were managed by the delivery manager and customer sponsor.
experienceHighlights.witness: Escalated schedule and resourcing risks to the delivery manager with an option each; consultant assignments were decided by the delivery manager, and customer go-live was signed off by the customer's project sponsor with the delivery manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Drafted close-out reports from action logs and call minutes, documenting open limitations and hand-over items for customer support.
experienceHighlights.witness: Drafted the close-out report for each implementation from the action log and the call minutes, listing open limitations and the hand-over items for customer support.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes action log export and close-out report for one implementation, with project tool record identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the action log export and the close-out report for one implementation, with the project tool's record identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Project tool proficiency for maintaining implementation plans, action logs, and consultant schedules.
skills.witness: Maintained the implementation plan, action log and consultant schedule for six enterprise implementations in the project tool, keeping the customer-facing status page current each week.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in maintaining implementation plans, action logs, and consultant schedules; hosting weekly status calls; escalating risks; and drafting close-out reports. However, they do not establish that the candidate held customer go-live sign-off or managed consultant assignments herself, as these were handled by the delivery manager and customer sponsor.
